reviews.x: I have owned my shaver for 8 days.  It provides the best shave I have ever had from an electric.  The problem is it isn't very durable. A shaver to be used in and out of the shower should be more durable in my opinion.

reviews.t: Nice shaver but not that great shaving dry or under the chin
reviews.x: I have been using mine for about two weeks.  It is the closest shave I have ever gotten from an electric razor.  You have to use it with the gell or shaving cream to get a close shave.  It is quiet and rather quick to use and the charge seems to hold for a long time.  It doesn't get under the chin well at all even with shaving cream or gell.  I shave my cheeks with the electric and use a regular razor to finish under my chin.

claims.text: Many reviewers say this electric shaver delivers the closest, least irritating shave they have had from an electric, with some calling it the best electric they have owned.
Several reviewers note the shave is not as close as a blade razor like the Mach 3, and some say a shadow returns by early afternoon.
Reviewers frequently complain that the Nivea shaving gel dispenser is annoying and difficult to use, with some preferring their own shaving cream.
Some reviewers report durability and build-quality concerns, including a head assembly that broke after a drop and a flimsy recharger holder.
A few reviewers say the shaver performs poorly on dry skin or under the chin and works best with gel or a wet face.
